top_signals.title: Ex-Temasek Holdings Executive to Lead Motilal Oswal’s Alternates Business
top_signals.summary: Padmanabh Sinha, who previously co-led Temasek Holdings Pte.’s India operations, will lead Motilal Oswal Financial Services’ alternative-investment business, as the firm bolsters its leadership team, the company said in a statement.
